claim: Heinanen and Guerin (1999, RFC 2697) specify a single-rate three-colour marker in which one rate CIR is shared by two buckets, C and E: tokens go to C first and to E only when C is full; a specification, with no measured gain.
Heinanen and Guerin (1999, RFC 2697): a packet is green and bucket Tc is decremented by its size B when Tc minus B is not below zero; a specification, with no measured gain.

Heinanen and Guerin (1999, RFC 2698) specify a two-rate three-colour marker with buckets P (rate PIR) and C (rate CIR); the packet is red if bucket P cannot cover its size B (Tp minus B below zero); a specification, with no measured gain.
Heinanen and Guerin (1999, RFC 2698): a packet is green and both Tp and Tc are decremented by B, so both buckets are charged for the same item; a specification, with no measured gain.
